Then we will get the result. The function will return "true" if the value is truthy and not "false" and passes validation. For contenteditable, valid values are "true", "false", "inherit", "plaintext-only". The function will check if the value is one of those. If so, it returns "true". So we should call the function with key "contenteditable" and value "plaintext-only". Then we will get "true". That means the appropriate boolean string representation is "true".
